context:
Grade the bundled Data Science exam's 20 multiple-choice questions for Synthetic Student 04 only. Exclude the short-answer questions (21-35). The authoritative MCQ answer key (answerkey.txt) is: 1=B, 2=C, 3=A, 4=C, 5=B, 6=A, 7=A, 8=C, 9=A, 10=B, 11=B, 12=C, 13=B, 14=C, 15=B, 16=C, 17=B, 18=C, 19=B, 20=B.
The listed answer options from Question.txt are:
1: A High multicollinearity, B Little or no autocorrelation, C Heteroscedasticity, D All of the mentioned
2: A Maximum, B Minimum, C Zero, D Unknown
3: A Hamming Distance, B Euclidean Distance, C Manhattan Distance, D Minkowski Distance
4: A Classification, B Regression, C Both A & B, D None of the mentioned
5: A Support Vector Machine, B Random Forest, C K-Nearest Neighbors, D Logistic Regression
6: A Voting, B Clustering, C Dimensionality Reduction, D Feature Engineering
7: A Zero, B One, C 0.5, D Depends on the dataset
8: A Bar Chart, B Box Plot, C Scatter Plot, D Histogram
9: A Points, B Lines, C Bars, D Areas
10: A Median, B Mean, C Mode, D Range
11: A A category, B A real number, C A boolean, D An image
12: A Data cleaning, B Column dropping, C Feature selection, D Normalization
13: A Classification, B Regression, C Clustering, D Association
14: A Linear Analysis, B Binary Analysis, C Time Series, D Discrete Analysis
15: A Linear Regression, B Logistic Regression, C Multiple Regression, D Polynomial Regression
16: A Data labels, B Input features, C Parameters of the ML algorithm set before training, D The final weights of a model
17: A True, B False
18: A In the first row, B In the upper diagonal, C Along the main diagonal, D In the last column
19: A TP / (TP + FN), B TP / (TP + FP), C TN / (TN + FP), D (TP + TN) / Total
20: A Outliers, B Support vectors, C Clusters, D Centroids
The Student_MCQ.csv row for Synthetic Student 04 is: Synthetic Student 04, Little or no autocorrelation, Zero, Hamming Distance, Both A & B, Logistic Regression, Voting, One, Scatter Plot, Points, Mean, A category, Feature selection, Regression, sequence analysis, Logistic Regression, Z, False, Along the main diagonal, B, (blank).
For every mark, report the response normalized by stripping surrounding spaces and uppercasing, so Little or no autocorrelation becomes LITTLE OR NO AUTOCORRELATION and a blank stays as an empty string. Report correct_answer as the keyed letter, e.g. B. Award 1 point for the correct option letter or for text that exactly matches the correct option after ignoring case and spacing; a small typo of one missing, extra, substituted or transposed character also earns 1 when the intended choice is unambiguous and its meaning is preserved, but an exact listed-option match takes precedence. Award 0 for incorrect listed options, off-option text, invalid letters, ambiguous matches and blanks. Include all 20 questions as marks sorted by question number, with possible=20 and score equal to the sum of points; total_score and total_possible mirror score and possible. Put exactly one entry in students named Synthetic Student 04.
